args.message: Fix money rounding to ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`src/money.py::round_money` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but the docstring and FIN-212 require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused `tests/test_money.py` to fail in the nightly build (e.g. `2.665` was rounded to `2.67` instead of `2.66`).

## Change
- Switched the rounding mode to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986`: **passed**.
